# TijaratkBot (تِجارتك بوت)

> The leading conversational commerce and AI sales platform in Egypt. Automate inbound customer inquiries, catalog browsing, cart management, and order extraction inside Facebook Messenger, Instagram DMs, and WhatsApp 24/7 with authentic Egyptian colloquial Arabic understanding.

## Core Documentation & AI Markdown Endpoints

- [Pricing & AI Fair Usage](/pricing.md): Complete tier details (Starter 499 EGP, Growth 749 EGP, Pro 1199 EGP), AI addon limits, generous Fair Usage Policy (FUP), and local Egyptian payment methods (InstaPay, Vodafone Cash, Meeza).
- [Frequently Asked Questions](/faq.md): Comprehensive Q&As covering setup, Egyptian dialect and Arabizi processing, WhatsApp Cloud API compliance, address parsing, and human handover.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works.md): 5-step operational blueprint detailing onboarding, catalog sync, instant AI sales responses, address parsing, and courier dispatch.
- [Features & Capabilities](/features.md): Technical deep-dive into colloquial dialect modeling, in-chat interactive cart, Egyptian address verification, and unified omnichannel inbox.
- [Blog & Guides](/blog.md): Practical e-commerce strategy articles and market benchmarks.
  - [TijaratkBot vs ArabyBot](/blog/tijaratkbot-vs-arabybot.md): High-converting dialect AI sales closer vs broadcast marketing tools in the Egyptian market.
  - [TijaratkBot vs BotOrders](/blog/tijaratkbot-vs-botorders.md): Conversational AI and automated NLP address extraction vs map webviews and rigid form flows.
  - [TijaratkBot vs Bosla](/blog/tijaratkbot-vs-bosla.md): Autonomous 24/7 AI sales closer vs multi-seat omnichannel CRM ticketing platforms.
  - [Why Sell From Your Chat Inbox](/blog/why-sell-from-chat-inbox.md): Why standalone websites lose over 70% of potential orders and how conversational commerce maximizes Cash on Delivery (COD) fulfillment.
